chapter.name: Bhakti Yoga
chapter.description: Krishna explains the path of devotion (bhakti) as the highest means to realize the divine. He compares personal devotion with meditation on the formless absolute and describes the qualities of true devotees.
chapter.theme: Path of devotion, surrender to God, and qualities of a true devotee
chapter.yogaType: Bhakti Yoga - Yoga of Devotion and Love

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते | ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | evaṃ satata-yuktā ye bhaktās tvāṃ paryupāsate | ye cāpy akṣaram avyaktaṃ teṣāṃ ke yoga-vittamāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: Who are better—those devoted to Your personal form or those who worship the formless?
verses.meaning: Arjuna asks about the best path of devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते | श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | mayy āveśya mano ye māṃ nitya-yuktā upāsate | śraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those who fix their mind on Me with devotion are considered the best.
verses.meaning: Personal devotion is the highest path.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते | सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम् ||
verses.transliteration: ye tv akṣaram anirdeśyam avyaktaṃ paryupāsate | sarvatra-gam acintyaṃ ca kūṭa-stham acalaṃ dhruvam ||
verses.english_translation: Those who worship the formless, unmanifest also reach Me.
verses.meaning: Both paths lead to the divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः | ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः ||
verses.transliteration: saṃniyamyendriya-grāmaṃ sarvatra sama-buddhayaḥ | te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those who control senses and are equal-minded also reach Me.
verses.meaning: Self-control and compassion lead to God.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम् | अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते ||
verses.transliteration: kleśo 'dhikataras teṣām avyaktāsakta-cetasām | avyaktā hi gatir duḥkhaṃ dehavadbhir avāpyate ||
verses.english_translation: The path of the unmanifest is more difficult for embodied beings.
verses.meaning: Devotion to personal God is easier.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः | अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते ||
verses.transliteration: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-parāḥ | ananyenaiva yogena māṃ dhyāyanta upāsate ||
verses.english_translation: Those who dedicate all actions to Me and meditate on Me reach Me.
verses.meaning: Surrendering actions leads to union.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् | भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम् ||
verses.transliteration: teṣām ahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyu-saṃsāra-sāgarāt | bhavāmi na cirāt pārtha mayy āveśita-cetasām ||
verses.english_translation: I quickly rescue such devotees from the cycle of death and rebirth.
verses.meaning: God protects devoted seekers.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय | निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः ||
verses.transliteration: mayy eva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśaya | nivasiṣyasi mayy eva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Fix your mind and intellect on Me; you will live in Me.
verses.meaning: Focus leads to divine union.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम् | अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय ||
verses.transliteration: atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram | abhyāsa-yogena tato mām icchāptuṃ dhanañjaya ||
verses.english_translation: If you cannot fix your mind, practice repeatedly.
verses.meaning: Practice strengthens devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव | मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि ||
verses.transliteration: abhyāse 'py asamartho 'si mat-karma-paramo bhava | mad-artham api karmāṇi kurvan siddhim avāpsyasi ||
verses.english_translation: If unable to practice, perform actions for Me.
verses.meaning: Selfless service is a path.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः | सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान् ||
verses.transliteration: athaitad apy aśakto 'si kartuṃ mad-yogam āśritaḥ | sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṃ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān ||
verses.english_translation: If unable, renounce the fruits of all actions.
verses.meaning: Detachment leads to peace.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते | ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम् ||
verses.transliteration: śreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṃ viśiṣyate | dhyānāt karma-phala-tyāgas tyāgāc chāntir anantaram ||
verses.english_translation: Knowledge is better than practice, meditation better than knowledge, and renunciation brings peace.
verses.meaning: Spiritual progress leads to inner peace.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च | निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ||
verses.transliteration: adveṣṭā sarva-bhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca | nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣamī ||
verses.english_translation: One who is free from hatred, friendly, compassionate, and humble is dear to Me.
verses.meaning: Qualities of a true devotee begin.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः | मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ||
verses.transliteration: santuṣṭaḥ satataṃ yogī yatātmā dṛḍha-niścayaḥ | mayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Content, self-controlled, and devoted—such a person is dear to Me.
verses.meaning: Devotion includes discipline and contentment.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः | हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ||
verses.transliteration: yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate ca yaḥ | harṣāmarṣa-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who neither disturbs others nor is disturbed is dear to Me.
verses.meaning: Calmness and balance define a true devotee.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः | हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ||
verses.transliteration: yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate ca yaḥ | harṣāmarṣa-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who neither disturbs others nor is disturbed is dear to Me.
verses.meaning: Calmness and balance define a true devotee.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः | सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ||
verses.transliteration: anapekṣaḥ śucir dakṣa udāsīno gata-vyathaḥ | sarvārambha-parityāgī yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who is free from expectations, pure, efficient, and detached is dear to Me.
verses.meaning: Detachment and purity are key virtues.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति | शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः ||
verses.transliteration: yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati | śubhāśubha-parityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who neither rejoices nor hates, neither grieves nor desires, is dear to Me.
verses.meaning: Freedom from emotional extremes.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः | शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः ||
verses.transliteration: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ | śītoṣṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣu samaḥ saṅga-vivarjitaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Equal in friend and enemy, honor and dishonor, heat and cold—such a person is dear to Me.
verses.meaning: Equanimity in all situations.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित् | अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः ||
verses.transliteration: tulya-nindā-stutir maunī santuṣṭo yena kenacit | aniketaḥ sthira-matir bhaktimān me priyo naraḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who is balanced in praise and blame, content, and steady-minded is dear to Me.
verses.meaning: Inner stability defines devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते | श्रद्धधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः ||
verses.transliteration: ye tu dharmyāmṛtam idaṃ yathoktaṃ paryupāsate | śraddadhānā mat-paramā bhaktās te 'tīva me priyāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those who follow this path of devotion with faith are exceedingly dear to Me.
verses.meaning: Faithful devotion is the highest spiritual path.
